name: Sam Okafor
summary: Second-year Mathematics and Computer Science student at King's College London looking for an internship.

details.text: Modules: Probability and Statistics, Algorithms and Data Structures, Linear Algebra, Databases
A-levels: Maths A*, Further Maths A, Physics A

bullets.text: Tutor 6 GCSE and A-level students each week in maths and further maths
Made worksheets based on each student's past paper mistakes
Talked to parents every month about how their child was getting on
Kept a spreadsheet of student marks to see who needed more help
Worked on the tills and helped customers find products
Helped with stock counts and noticed that some shelves were often empty on Mondays
Covered extra shifts during the Christmas period
Used Python and pandas to pull and clean TfL open data on tube delays
Made charts in Tableau showing which lines were worst at different times of day
Wrote a short blog post explaining what I found for non-technical readers
Helped build a web app for booking library study rooms in 24 hours
Wrote the SQL queries for checking which rooms were free
Presented the app to the judges at the end
In charge of the society's money and keeping track of spending
Worked with the committee to plan events for around 150 members
Asked local companies for sponsorship and got two to say yes
